page.overview:
Who is Salmar?

Salmar was a Maia, creator of the Ulumúri. Made for his lord the Vala Ulmo, the Ulumúri were great who produced the music of the Sea. That he was a Maia is confirmed only in the index of .

Salmar is a Quenya name of unspecified meaning. It was possibly derived from the Quenya word salma, meaning "lyre".

In earlier versions of the legendarium discussed in , Salmar is often identified by the title Noldorin (sometimes "Lirillo" or "Golthadriel" in Gnomish, later Sindarin). He was envisioned as a Vala in the service of Aulë.
